verified_contracts: Pinned installed CLI reports exactly OpenCode 1.18.4.

Four native scenarios passed: custom-openai/glm-5.2 with web denied; custom-openai/qwen3.8-max with web denied; aliyun-glm-5.2 with web denied; custom-openai/glm-5.2 without web denials as a positive control.

All fixture HTTP requests carry the dummy Bearer key and correct model, temperature=0, seed=42, enable_thinking=true, reasoning_effort=high, max_tokens=32000; response_format and camelCase reasoningEffort are absent.
Qwen historical assistant tool-call messages preserve synthetic reasoning_content=fixture-reasoning through the root and child tool round trips.
Native root delegates to general and explore; each child reads README then continues. Exactly six task requests, four child task requests, three stored sessions and four tool calls are accounted.
Fixture usage totals are input=600 including cache, output=300 including reasoning, cache=360, reasoning=120, text=180; root input=200 and child input=400.
At least one extra title/summary request is observed, and its request settings are checked. Such extra unstored requests are not included in the six persisted task LLM calls.
read/grep/glob remain exposed in native task requests; websearch/webfetch are absent with global/built-in-agent denials and exposed by the positive-control removal.

Usage units cover recursive/grandchild/resumed sessions, duplicate de-duplication, missing/empty/unfinished child failures, mixed accounting rejection, unknown costs, root answer preservation and collection-wall accounting.
Adapter units verify finally-block snapshot capture and preserve original run errors while failing accounting closed.

credentials_and_network_boundary.runner_environment: Explicit minimal environment; host API/auth/proxy environment variables were not inherited. Only the test-created offline-fixture-not-a-real-key reaches the native fixture.
credentials_and_network_boundary.provider_endpoint: Every native scenario rewrites provider baseURL to a fresh http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 ThreadingHTTPServer.
credentials_and_network_boundary.native_home: Each scenario uses a fresh temporary HOME and XDG config/data/state/cache; no user auth or config is imported.
credentials_and_network_boundary.dependency_network: Package installation fetched npm registry artifacts. This is an offline model contract test, not a claim of globally air-gapped execution.
credentials_and_network_boundary.not_verified: No packet capture or OS network sandbox was used; web-tool denial is not proof of shell/network isolation. No real provider effective sampling behavior, availability, cost or Qwen answer quality was tested.

accounting_boundary.meaning_of_complete: Complete persisted root and recursively linked task sessions, not complete provider billing.
accounting_boundary.excluded: Unstored title/background requests, judge calls and embedding/index setup are outside this scope.
accounting_boundary.cost: Absent or zero custom-provider pricing remains unknown; no dollar-cost claim is supported.

coverage_not_run: Actual zg MCP search or embedding endpoint
fixture_retention: Four fake-provider cases retained under native-tools/fixtures, each with root eventstream, usage snapshot/report, root and two child full exports; no real model/provider data. Qwen fixture is case-02.
limits: Assertions establish the fixed CLI/harness wire and stored-usage contract under a deterministic fake provider. They do not validate model capability or the forthcoming experiment outcome.

supplemental_fixture_capture.reason: Requested actual native export/eventstream shapes for wrapper full-tool audit after the original tests had cleaned temporary fixtures.

results.note: Supplemental rerun of unchanged native test; external TemporaryDirectory cleanup subclass copies fake fixtures and executes read-only export before original cleanup.

supplemental_fixture_capture.collection_change: External temporary-directory cleanup subclass copies fake fixture files and executes read-only opencode export for each captured usage session before normal cleanup.
